name: Stick-figure explainer reel (Hermes /stick-figure)
description: A bright cartoon world with stick people, constant camera motion, whip transitions and 1 to 2 word captions timed to the voice. A full reel Hermes makes with /stick-figure.

cautions: Research only: a Hermes render is never published.
Hermes renders with the claude-animation-skills skill installed there; record what it used.
Captions: Poppins Bold, white with a dark outline, 1 to 2 words, lowercase, no punctuation; no em dashes on screen.
Bright saturated palette, ink outlines, slow push-ins with handheld drift, whip transitions with motion blur.
Check every claim with sources and hedge theories; SFX and a quiet plucked underscore sit under the voice.

hermes.input: A full project, not a quick spec. Use the run's narration (narration.url) as the voiceover and time the skill's captions and shots to it word by word where possible; the run's captions are the text to show. Do not record or synthesise a new voice unless the narration is missing, and say so in the reply's notes if you had to. Use the storyboard's shots as the shot list (about 10 to 12 setups, most 2 to 4 s, the explainer shot longer; the hook in action on frame 1; faces and key props out of the caption band) and the run's script order (hook, belief, the "But" turn, examples, payoff). Keep the skill's style rules.
hermes.output: A finished reel (1080x1920 H.264 MP4, 30 fps) with the run's narration and the skill's captions and sound, published under /clip/ on the media host. It is a reel the studio then QCs (qc-video) and the owner scores on Review; it is never published.
